status: prospective; candidate not yet supplied or independently implemented; no speedup/equivalence admitted
comparison: Pair baseline and candidate recipes on exactly the same application source, compiler inputs, native SDK content and build environment; comparing historical to integration source is descriptive only

identity_boundaries.source: full immutable Git commit, clean archive/context inventory, submodules and candidate patch SHA256; changes outside declared recipe/selector are rejected
identity_boundaries.sdk_recipe: base OCI digest, Debian snapshot and resolved package inventory, all native scripts/locks, source commits/submodules/download hashes, compiler/tool versions, complete CMake settings and build args
identity_boundaries.sdk_content: actual native-link inputs archive SHA256 AND sorted per-file archive/header/link-environment inventory; recipe identity alone does not attest output bytes
identity_boundaries.oci: index, selected platform manifest, config and every blob digest/length; OCI metadata may differ while payload identity remains exact
identity_boundaries.application: seven executable-role SHA256 values must match paired baseline; no glob or mtime artifact selection; require real Cargo compiler-artifact JSON and exact package/target/test-profile identity
identity_boundaries.materials: path/type/mode/size/SHA256 inventory, licenses/notices, Cargo vendor closure, glibc sources, native static archives and original source; compressed archive identity and extracted content identity recorded separately

acceptance: No PT_INTERP or DT_NEEDED on all seven real ELF executables; preserve readelf stdout and exit status
Exact role binary hashes, all original compile commands/flags/profiles/features and static checks unchanged
Run engine, server, lifecycle and deployment acceptance with exact candidate bytes at original one/two CPU limits
Fresh builder with no local native state materializes SDK from immutable digest, verifies every blob/content input and links all seven roles without rebuilding native sources
Missing/corrupt/truncated SDK blob or archive fails closed; rejected wrong platform, recipe, compiler, flags, archive inventory or source scope retained
Trusted release signing policy unchanged; no fork writes, mutable broad trust, or unverified SDK fallback
phase_measurement: Record actual phase command, monotonic elapsed time, exit/signal, child CPU time/maxRSS, stdout/stderr SHA256 and enclosing execution identity. BuildKit client cgroup is not proof of daemon worker limits. Old combined RUN costs cannot be split retrospectively
cache_scenarios: application-only edit on fresh builder with transported dependency/SDK state

measurement_design.order: alternate baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline; freeze schedule before execution
measurement_design.budget: identical explicit builder CPU/memory/affinity and storage/network policy; record host/cgroup identity and throttling
measurement_design.report: all attempts including failure/cache miss; paired elapsed ratios and bootstrap intervals only after enough completed pairs; no claim from synthetic selectors or single historical runs

chef_experiment: Separate incremental candidate after durable SDK; preserve /app root workspace and /app/shared plus /app/runtime external path references, identical working directory, compiler/native/profile/flags and all seven roles. No cache-mount cross-runner persistence claim without explicit transport. Cook must materialize a compiled dependency layer bound to SDK-content/toolchain/profile/flags. Prepare-only success is insufficient
